objects: E; V; nonnegative α,β and real η; center y, reference r, phase states (x,v); c, Φ, S, rate, Λ, τ, next, record; Ω=R^N with exponential product P and positive-part thresholds ε; finite histories Hist, readTime/liveTime, Δ, Prefix with induced measure m, zAt, K, qReal/q; A, eventTime, I, totalized least index N, d, survival, weight, C; Path, Ψ, Γ, ρ; velocity reversal R, potential V_y, normalized tilted product measure ν_y; the existential global process Z and endpoint measures σ_n,L_n,Q and map J. All definitions are reconstructed in reconstruction.txt.
domains: E is any finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero. V:E→R; α,β∈[0,∞); η∈R. y,r∈E; z,z₀∈E×E. Flow time t∈R; waiting time, horizon and thresholds are nonnegative; τ and eventTime take values in [0,∞]. Ω=R^N. Hist(n) has n+1 live-or-stopped records. Prefix(n,T) is 0<t₁<⋯<t_n<T, with an empty singleton for n=0. Path(T) consists of functions from [0,T] to E×E. Endpoint measures live on (E×E)×(E×E).
quantifiers: For every displayed ambient structure, V, α, β, η satisfying the hypotheses, there exists a single jointly measurable Z. Its interpolation implication holds for every y,r,z₀,w,s,n and live record a. Its fallback holds for every y,r,z₀,w,s with no qualifying n. For every fixed y,r,z₀, initialization holds for P-almost every w. For every y,r,T, the three endpoint-measure assertions hold, with the sum over every n∈N.
assumptions: α>0; α≤β; α and β are nonnegative by type; V is C² in the real Frechet sense; for every x,v, α||v||²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β||v||²; η>0; βη≤1. E has the stated normed, inner-product, finite-dimensional, measurable and Borel structures. All let bindings, existence/measurability of Z, initialization, measure expansion, probability and preservation are definitions or conclusions, not additional assumptions.
conclusion: Existence of jointly measurable Z with the exact pointwise live-record flow interpolation and initial-state fallback, parameterwise almost-everywhere initialization, and, for every y,r,T, Q=Σ_n (B_n)_*[(ν_y×m(n,T)).withDensity(ρ)], Q of total mass one, and measurable J(z,z′)=(Rz′,Rz) with J_*Q=Q. Here Q is the pushforward of ν_y×P under (z,w)↦(z,Z(y,r,z,T,w)). Full formulas and exceptional cases are in reconstruction.txt.
scopes: All constructions share fixed V,η. y,r are unrestricted independent deterministic parameters. Prefix strict times exclude T, whereas I brackets with eventTime_n≤T<eventTime_(n+1). Almost-everywhere initialization is inside universal fixed-parameter quantifiers and does not assert one common null set. The final reversal assertion is about the ordered endpoint pair, with the same y,r. N,A,C and arbitrary-history path definitions have exactly the scopes supplied; no separate theorem about N or C is asserted. No uniqueness, full path-law reversal, rate, error bound, or explicit everywhere nonexplosion claim is included.
constant_dependencies: Unit-rate exponential input; reflection factor 2; quadratic penalty 1/(2η); α,β are Hessian bounds with βη≤1 and α>0. Flow and rate use sqrt(η); constructions depend on V,η and displayed y,r,z₀,T,n, not directly on α,β. Z is chosen for fixed admissible ambient data and works simultaneously for its five displayed inputs. No positive dimension lower bound is imposed. Real division by zero, positive-part conversions, truncated nonnegative subtraction, infinite hitting time, stopped records, empty products, and absent-index fallback use the explicit conventions.
